sections.normalized_html:
We are given that [MATH: \ell] and [MATH: k] are parallel. Since line [MATH: p] intersects both lines [MATH: \ell] and [MATH: k,] it's a transversal.

The angle whose measure is [MATH: 152^\circ] and the angle whose measure is [MATH: x^\circ] are corresponding pairs of angles since they are located in the same position as each other relative to the parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal.

When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, corresponding angles are congruent. So, [MATH: x^\circ = 152^\circ.] Therefore, we can conclude that [MATH: x = \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid gainsboro]{152}.]

sections.normalized_html:
The angles labeled [MATH: 154^\circ] and [MATH: x^\circ] are on a straight line at the point where the transversal [MATH: t] intersects the line [MATH: j.]

Since angles on a straight line form a linear pair, their measures must sum to [MATH: 180^\circ.] So, we can write

[MATH: x^\circ + 154^\circ = 180^\circ.]

items.title: Using Corresponding and Supplementary Angles

sections.normalized_html: In the diagram above, lines [MATH: m] and [MATH: n] are parallel, and the line [MATH: t] intersects both. What is the value of [MATH: x?]
sections.readable_text:

In the diagram above, lines [MATH: m] and [MATH: n] are parallel, and the line [MATH: t] intersects both. What is the value of [MATH: x?]

sections.normalized_html:
Since lines [MATH: m] and [MATH: n] are parallel, and the line [MATH: t] acts as a transversal, the angle labeled [MATH: 143^\circ] and the angle adjacent to [MATH: x^\circ] outside the parallel lines are corresponding angles. Hence, they are congruent.

The angle labeled [MATH: x^\circ] and the adjacent angle form a linear pair, creating a straight angle at the point of intersection of [MATH: t] and [MATH: n.] The measure of a straight angle is [MATH: 180^\circ.] Therefore, we have [MATH: x^\circ + 143^\circ = 180^\circ.] Solving for [MATH: x,] we get [MATH: x^\circ = 180^\circ - 143^\circ = 37^\circ.] Therefore, we conclude that [MATH: x = \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid gainsboro]{37}.]
